sovereign_country.strategic_role: 极速离岸证券与外汇交易商持牌（VFSC）、轻资产免税出海

business_scope.primary_industry_name: Wholesale International Distribution of Acetate Eyeglass Frames

meta_jurisdiction_context.legal_system_doctrine: Hybrid (English common law foundation with French civil law historical influence and customary law; International Company law follows common law IBC statutory model)
applicable_bilateral_investment_treaties: World Trade Organization (WTO) membership since 2012 - MFN and TRIMS disciplines applicable to foreign investment
Pacific Agreement on Closer Economic Relations (PACER Plus) - regional trade and economic integration framework
Melanesian Spearhead Group (MSG) Trade Agreement - regional trade agreement among Pacific island states
No comprehensive double taxation agreement is currently in force for Vanuatu International Companies; domestic IC income is tax-exempt

ubo_and_aml_profiling.statutory_law_governance: Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2011, as amended by the Financial Transactions Reporting (Amendment) Act 2015 and subsequent AML/CFT amendments; International Companies Act [Cap. 222], as amended; VFSC AML/CFT Rules and Guidance; Companies Register beneficial ownership filing obligations as administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized certified copy of passport of each director, shareholder, and ultimate beneficial owner
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the applicant's country of origin
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.authentication_path: Hague Apostille (for countries party to the Apostille Convention) or Consular Legalization (for non-Convention countries)

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Notarized Power of Attorney appointing the local registered agent
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Notary public in the applicant's country of origin

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certificate of Incumbency or Good Standing certificate for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation of the corporate shareholder

mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.document_name: Certified copy of certificate of incorporation for any corporate shareholder
mandatory_notarization_and_apostille_bun.issuing_entity: Corporate registry of the jurisdiction of incorporation of the corporate shareholder

ubo_and_aml_profiling.pep_and_sanctions_screening_protocols: Mandatory customer due diligence under the Financial Transactions Reporting Act 2011 and VFSC AML/CFT Rules: verify all directors, shareholders, UBOs, and authorized signatories; screen against the United Nations Security Council consolidated list, OFAC SDN list, EU/UK sanctions lists, and domestic Vanuatu enforcement lists; PEPs are classified as higher-risk and require senior management approval, source of funds verification, and enhanced ongoing monitoring.

statutory_name_clearance_protocol.registry_portal_name: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Company Registry and e-Registry portal for International Companies
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.language_and_transliteration_doctrine: International Company names must be in Latin/Roman script and use English, French, or a combination; non-Latin script names must be filed as an approved Romanized transliteration; the name must be distinguishable from all existing registered names and must not imply a connection with Vanuatu government unless lawfully authorized.
statutory_name_clearance_protocol.extension_and_rejection_appeal_sop: Upon rejection, the applicant or its registered agent may file a written administrative review request with the VFSC Registry within 14 days of the rejection notice, including a revised proposed name; if the administrative review is refused, the applicant may appeal to the Minister responsible for financial services in accordance with the International Companies Act; judicial review before the Supreme Court of Vanuatu is available for procedural or jurisdictional error.

registered_office_and_commercial_substan.virtual_office_permissibility: A physical registered office in Vanuatu and a licensed resident registered agent are mandatory for every International Company; a stand-alone virtual office without a physical service provider is not permissible. However, the registered agent may lawfully provide the registered office address and administrative substance services for a wholesale distribution company in the optical frames industry.
registered_office_and_commercial_substan.physical_inspection_likelihood: Low quantified risk: less than 10% likelihood of unannounced physical on-site inspection in the first three years for a low-risk wholesale importer/exporter of ophthalmic eyewear frames, absent specific AML/CFT risk triggers, adverse sanctions screening results, or material inconsistencies in UBO declarations; VFSC and relevant law enforcement authorities retain full legal authority to conduct inspections if warranted.

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC name clearance and availability check
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory/regulatory fee schedule of the VFSC Registry

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: VFSC incorporation fee and Certificate of Incorporation issuance
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Statutory/regulatory fee schedule of the International Companies Act

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Registered agent service, including statutory registered office for first year
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for licensed registered agents in Vanuatu

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: KYC/UBO due diligence and customer compliance package
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing market benchmark for AML/CFT compliance services

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Notarization and Apostille/consular legalization bundle for up to four corporate and individual documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.charging_authority: Notary public and competent authentication authority in document origin country
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Prevailing notarial fee schedule and Hague Apostille/consular legalization tariff

pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.expense_line_item: Courier and secure transmission of original certified documents
pre_incorporation_itemized_budget_usd.legal_fee_basis: Market rate for expedited international document courier service

incorporation_legal_framework.governing_statute_and_sections: International Companies Act No. 27 of 2020 (Republic of Vanuatu), ss. 6, 10, 21–22, 27 and 45; read with the International Companies Regulations and the VFSC Consolidated Fee Schedule; Business Licence Act [Cap 6] ancillary only if a physical trading premises is established onshore.
incorporation_legal_framework.competent_registry_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — Registry of International Companies, Port Vila, Republic of Vanuatu
incorporation_legal_framework.statutory_filing_instrument: Form IC-01 (Application for Registration of an International Company) together with the Constitution (Memorandum and Articles of Association) and the Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent
incorporation_legal_framework.minimum_paid_up_capital_rule: No statutory minimum paid-up capital. An International Company may issue shares with or without par value in any currency; the sole subscriber may take one or more shares fully or partly paid. No escrow account or paid-up capital deposit is required, and capital verification relies solely on the subscriber declaration contained in the Constitution.
incorporation_legal_framework.pro_forma_first_board_resolution_en: RESOLVED: the allotment of one no-par-value ordinary share to the sole subscriber be and is approved. The Constitution lodged with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission is ratified. The Registered Office at the Registered Agent's premises in Port Vila, Vanuatu, is adopted. The Registered Agent agreement is approved. [Name] and [Name] are hereby appointed Director and Corporate Secretary, respectively, to hold office until resignation or removal. All pre-incorporation expenses of the incorporator are ratified. The Director and Secretary are authorized, jointly or severally, to affix the seal, execute statutory filings, and establish banking mandates for Swift TT and platform payment rails.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) Name-Search Section, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Reserve two alternative corporate names by submitting a name availability check at the VFSC registry counter or through a licensed registered agent. The Registrar will reject names that are identical, phonetically similar, or contravene the International Companies Act 2020 (e.g., names implying government patronage or restricted words such as 'Trust', 'Assurance', 'Bank' without a consent).
required_dossiers: Name Reservation Application (Form IC-01A)
Subscriber identification (certified passport copy and proof of residential address)
Proposed Constitution draft
Registered agent engagement letter
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the name is queried, resubmit alternative names within 5 business days at no additional fee. Typographical corrections are cured administratively, while a formal objection by a third party is determined by the Registrar after written submissions; an appeal lies to the VFSC Board within 21 days of the refusal.

step_by_step_formation_sop.step_name: Execution of Constitution and Collection of Consents
step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Sole Subscriber, Proposed Directors, and VFSC-Licensed Registered Agent
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: The sole subscriber executes the Constitution, and the Registered Agent executes the Consent to Act as Registered Agent together with the registered office address consent. Proposed directors and the corporate secretary execute their consent forms. Original wet-ink or notarized execution must be retained; scans are acceptable for VFSC pre-clearance but originals must be available on request.
required_dossiers: Executed Constitution (Memorandum and Articles of Association)
Form IC-02 (Consent of Registered Agent)
Registered office address consent or short-form lease
Form IC-03 (Consents of each proposed director and the secretary)
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Defective execution is cured by re-signing the affected signature pages. Where foreign subscribers require legalization, a Vanuatu consular notarization or apostille-style authentication must be appended; the corrected dossier is resubmitted within 10 days of the deficiency notice.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Registry of International Companies, Port Vila
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Submit Form IC-01 together with the executed Constitution, consents, and notices at the VFSC Registry window or via the approved registered agent portal. Pay the USD 300 incorporation fee (Vatu equivalent) by bank transfer, card, or cashier's order at the VFSC cashier, and retain the stamped lodgement receipt as evidence of submission.
required_dossiers: Form IC-01 (Application for Registration of an International Company)
Executed Constitution
Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent
Director and Secretary consent forms
VFSC fee payment receipt
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If a deficiency query is raised, file a supplementary answering statement within 14 days of the notice. Late or unanswered queries may result in rejection, requiring refiling with a new application cover sheet and a reduced administrative fee per the VFSC fee schedule.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, Registry of International Companies
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Upon approval, VFSC registers the International Company, allocates the unique registration number, and issues the Certificate of Incorporation bearing the date of registration. Verify the company name, registration number, and date, and obtain certified copies of the Constitution and registered agent notices from VFSC.
required_dossiers: VFSC Certificate of Incorporation
Certified copy of the Constitution
Notice of Registered Office and Registered Agent
Share certificate(s) executed by the directors
Register of members, directors, and secretary
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: Clerical errors on the certificate are corrected by lodging Form IC-10 (Rectification of Register) with VFSC at the prescribed fee. Any substantive post-registration amendment requires a special resolution and filing of the amendment with the Registrar.

step_by_step_formation_sop.competent_authority: Board of Directors and Corporate Secretary (with Registered Agent)
step_by_step_formation_sop.detailed_action_protocol: Convene the first board meeting or pass a written resolution approving the share allotment, adoption of the registered office, appointment of officers, seal, and bank mandate. Open the corporate bank account using the Certificate of Incorporation, tax-exempt confirmation, board resolution, and KYC pack, designating signatories for Swift TT and platform payment rails.
required_dossiers: Certified Certificate of Incorporation
First Board Resolution (written minutes or unanimous resolution)
Constitution and registered agent notices
Directors' and secretary's identification and proof of address
Bank account opening forms and beneficial ownership declaration
step_by_step_formation_sop.adverse_action_remedies: If the bank queries economic substance, provide the ISIC 4646 wholesale distribution business plan, the VFSC certificate confirming no statutory license is required, and pro forma contracts. Incomplete statutory registers are remedied by completing the register of beneficial owners and members within 21 days of discovery to avoid a late-filing penalty.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.competent_industrial_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (statutory overseas trading authorization); Vanuatu Investment Promotion Authority (VIPA) and Municipal Business Licence Office (optional physical-presence licensing only if an onshore warehouse is established)
industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.operating_license_title: International Company Certificate of Incorporation (VFSC) — valid offshore wholesale authorization; optional Business Licence under the Business Licence Act [Cap 6] if a physical distribution warehouse is operated in Port Vila or Luganville

environmental_impact_assessment_eia.agency_name: Department of Environmental Protection and Conservation (DEPC), Ministry of Climate Change, Meteorology, Geo-hazards, Energy, Environment and National Disaster Management (MCCMME), Republic of Vanuatu
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.classification_tier: Exempt — wholesale warehousing of assembled acetate eyeglass frames involves no industrial processing, manufacturing effluent, or point-source emissions; no EIA Report or Environmental Registration is required under the Environmental Protection Act [Cap 283]. A Category C (Registration-level) screening would apply only if a future on-site assembly or frame-finishing line were installed and discharge thresholds were exceeded.
environmental_impact_assessment_eia.discharge_and_emissions_standards: No point-source trade wastewater anticipated; if any incidental discharge occurs, DEPC benchmarks apply: BOD5 ≤ 30 mg/L, TSS ≤ 50 mg/L, pH 6–9, and hydrocarbons/degreasers ≤ 5 mg/L. Workplace VOC exposure guideline is 75 mg/m³ (occupational ceiling); no ozone-depleting solvents permitted. Cardboard, molded pulp, and PE packaging must be segregated for recycling under the Vanuatu Waste Management Regulations, and single-use plastic bags are prohibited pursuant to the Single-Use Plastic Regulations 2021.

industry_physical_and_environmental_lice.civil_defense_and_occupational_clearance: Fire Safety Clearance from the Vanuatu Fire Service (Vanuatu Police Force) covering means of egress, extinguisher coverage, and separation of stored goods; structural load inspection certificate from the Port Vila Municipal Council Building Inspectorate or the Luganville City Council as applicable; occupational workplace clearance under the Employment Act [Cap 160] Part V covering ventilation, electrical safety, manual handling, and first-aid readiness.

national_tax_registration_infrastructure.competent_tax_authority: Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue (DCIR), Ministry of Finance and Economic Management — portal: https://customs.gov.vu; corporate registry: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) — portal: https://vfsc.vu
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.tax_id_procurement_sop: Foreign entities incorporate an International Company (IC) under the International Companies Act [Cap. 222] through a VFSC-licensed registered agent; the VFSC-issued Certificate of Incorporation (company number) serves as the sole statutory tax-identification document. No TIN or national-tax file is issued or required for a tax-exempt IC. Only if the entity voluntarily engages in a domestic taxable activity must it register for VAT with the DCIR (Form VAT 1) and obtain a municipal business licence (e.g., Port Vila); hiring local staff additionally triggers employer payroll-tax registration at 4%.
national_tax_registration_infrastructure.statutory_election_mechanisms: None tax-related: Vanuatu has no income tax, no check-the-box regime, and no hybrid-mismatch or CFC election. Corporate elections available under the IC Act (application of Companies Act, conversion to/from local company, continuation of a foreign company into Vanuatu, and extension of the statutory 20-year tax-exemption guarantee up to a maximum of 40 years) do not alter exempt status.

indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.indirect_tax_system_name: Value Added Tax (VAT) — VAT Act No. 15 of 1998 [Cap. 143]
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.statutory_registration_threshold_local_c: VUV 3,000,000 (Vanuatu Vatu) of annual taxable supplies triggers compulsory VAT registration; voluntary registration is permitted below threshold. A pure offshore wholesale IC distributing ophthalmic eyeglass frames has no domestic taxable nexus and cannot be compelled to register.
indirect_taxation_nexus_and_rules.electronic_invoicing_and_clearance_manda: None: no real-time fiscal clearance, e-invoicing API, or digital stamping regime exists. Export declarations are filed through the ASYCUDA World customs platform; VAT invoices are issued on paper or private software without state validation.

export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.zero_rating_eligibility: 0% VAT applies to goods physically exported from Vanuatu within 28 days of supply and to services supplied to non-residents and consumed wholly offshore. For the IC, all offshore wholesale sales of acetate eyeglass frames are statutorily exempt from any tax, with or without VAT registration; no FX repatriation deadline applies (no exchange-control regime), so export proceeds may be retained offshore indefinitely.
mandatory_customs_documentation_bundle: Customs Export Declaration (ASYCUDA World electronic declaration, Form E1)
Bill of Lading or Air Waybill evidencing physical export within the statutory period
Certificate of Origin (only where preferential tariff treatment is claimed)
Evidence of settlement (SWIFT/MT103 or platform-payout record) for refund substantiation
export_zero_rating_and_refund_substantia.audit_scrutiny_and_clawback_penalties: Fraudulent or unsupported export zero-rating claims by a VAT-registered exporter trigger de-registration, repayment of refunds, additional assessment plus penalty up to 200% of the VAT evaded, fines, and imprisonment; retroactive clawback may reach back 5 years. Unrepatriated FX is not a clawback trigger: Vanuatu imposes no exchange controls, and the 0-day statutory deadline reflects this nil repatriation obligation.

fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.central_bank_authority: Reserve Bank of Vanuatu (RBV) — the sole monetary authority and regulator of the Vatu (VUV), operating in conjunction with the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) for non-bank financial institutions and international company service providers.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.currency_convertibility_assessment: Vanuatu is an IMF Article VIII member: current-account payments and transfers are free from governmental restrictions. There is no separate exchange-control law; the VUV is managed against a trade-weighted basket of major currencies. Profit remittances, dividends, and internal corporate transfers may be freely effected via authorized banks, subject only to standard AML/CTF and source-of-funds verification. Capital-account transactions are also generally unrestricted, although banks may apply internal due-diligence thresholds and require supporting board resolutions and underlying trade contracts for large inbound equity injections.
fx_control_regime_and_central_bank_regul.export_proceeds_surrender_rules: Vanuatu imposes no statutory export proceeds surrender requirement. No mandatory conversion ratio applies, and no fixed statutory timeline exists for repatriation or conversion of export receipts. Authorized banks may require declarative reporting under RBV statistical data-collection powers, but export proceeds may be held in VUV or any freely accepted foreign currency at the exporter's commercial discretion.

corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.fintech_emi_cross_border_viability: Low feasibility for offshore digital EMI-only relationships. Vanuatu does not operate a distinct e-money institution (EMI) license track; overseas digital EMIs are not authorised to open domestic settlement accounts or provide local payment services unless separately licensed by the VFSC as a financial institution or international banking entity. Tier-1 commercial banks generally decline to provision operational banking services to offshore EMI platforms for corporate clients due to regulatory ambiguity and correspondent-bank de-risking pressure.
corporate_banking_onboarding_blueprint.physical_presence_and_kyc_interview_mand: For first-time corporate onboarding, Vanuatu's tier-1 banks require at least one director and the beneficial owner (or an authorised signatory with equivalent seniority) to attend a physical KYC interview in Port Vila. Full remote opening for new legal entities is generally not available. Banks may permit a video-call interview only for account renewals or low-risk supplementary signatories after the initial in-person due-diligence meeting.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Tax-exempt International Company (IC) with nominee director or shareholder
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Banks require (i) the IC's certificate of incorporation, (ii) a current certificate of incumbency naming the ultimate beneficial owner, (iii) the full registered-agent and registered-office agreement, (iv) an executed declaration of trust or nominee acknowledgment, (v) a group structure chart demonstrating actual control and economic ownership, and (vi) a corporate resolution ratifying the account mandate.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: High-value cross-border wires inconsistent with industry risk profile
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Present purchase orders and invoices from reputable eyewear manufacturers, full trade contracts, inspection certificates, shipping logistics documents, customs declarations, and a monthly cash-flow projection aligned with the ISIC 4646 wholesale distribution model.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Source of funds from opaque private investment vehicles
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Deliver six months of bank statements from the funding entity, audited financial statements, tax receipts in the jurisdiction of origin, a notarised statement of source of wealth signed by the beneficial owner, and independent asset-history documentation where the accumulating capital exceeds USD 1,000,000.

critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.trigger_point: Multiple signatories or directors with politically exposed person (PEP) status
critical_aml_kyc_blockers_and_defense.evidentiary_defense_dossier: Submit official PEP status declarations, independent risk-assessment reports, proof of legitimate remuneration, legal-source letters from each PEP regime, and documented corporate approval of any high-risk signatory's account authority.

cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.inbound_capital_injection_routing: Inbound equity and shareholder funding from foreign jurisdictions must be effected via SWIFT MT103 (customer credit transfer) or MT202 (bank-to-bank funds transfer) to a commercial bank account in Vanuatu, with the purpose code clearly marked 'EQUITY CAPITAL INJECTION' or 'LOAN PRINCIPAL UNDER SHAREHOLDER AGREEMENT' where applicable. The receiving bank requires a board resolution authorising the capital increase or subordinated loan, the signed shareholder agreement or subscription contract, an updated register of members, and a statement confirming the funds originate from a non-sanctioned banking institution. The VUV is fully convertible at the receiving bank's prevailing T/T rate; no RBV prior approval is required for capital receipts.
cross_border_liquidity_and_clearing_rail.outbound_trade_disbursements: Trade settlements for wholesale procurement of acetate eyeglass frames and related optical components should prioritise SWIFT MT103 documentary payments against commercial invoices, Pro Forma invoices, and signed purchase contracts. For high-value or repeat shipments, an irrevocable commercial letter of credit (L/C) issued by a Vanuatu tier-1 bank, payable at sight or via deferred payment terms, can be used with the beneficiary's bank in Hong Kong, mainland China, Taiwan, Japan, or South Korea. Where interbank liquidity is required between the Vanuatu clearing account and offshore correspondent accounts, an MT202 COVER instruction is used. Settlement is cleared in VUV, USD, AUD, or EUR based on the underlying supplier currency; there are no exchange-control restrictions on outgoing trade payments.
permissible_fx_hedging_instruments: USD/VUV deliverable forward contracts with tenors up to 12 months offered by tier-1 commercial banks for import payable hedging
AUD/VUV deliverable forward contracts for procurement from Australian and Pacific-rim suppliers
EUR/VUV forward contracts for European frame manufacturers where bilateral bank lines permit
Participating forward structures (forward with partial option) subject to bank approval for recurring purchase programmes
Cross-currency interest-rate swaps denominated in VUV against USD or AUD for multi-year funding facilities, subject to board approval and appropriate derivatives documentation

Non-deliverable forwards (NDFs) are restricted in the onshore Vanuatu market due to limited depth; NDFs may be executed via offshore parent or affiliate treasury centres only after demonstrating legitimate commercial exposure and obtaining domestic bank acknowledgment

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual International Company Government License Fee (renewal of IC registration and tax-exempt status)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: Vanuatu Financial Services Commission (VFSC) via the licensed resident Registered Agent
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Payable on or before each anniversary of the date of incorporation; the Registered Agent issues an invoice approximately 60 days before the anniversary. The standard tier is VT 25,000 (approximately USD 220); VT 50,000 and VT 75,000 tiers apply where issued capital exceeds VT 100,000 and VT 1,000,000 respectively.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: A 10% late-payment surcharge accrues immediately on any unpaid anniversary fee; if fees and penalties remain unpaid for 3 months after the anniversary date, the Registrar may initiate administrative strike-off under section 75 of the International Companies Act (Cap. 222), resulting in dissolution and vesting of assets in the Republic of Vanuatu.

annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deliverable: Annual Beneficial Ownership and AML Customer Due Diligence Refresh Confirmation
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.receiving_authority: VFSC-licensed resident Registered Agent (maintained in agent files and subject to VFSC AML/CFT examination)
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.statutory_deadline_window: Annually within 12 months of the preceding CDD review, aligned with the incorporation-anniversary renewal cycle; updates required within 30 days of any share-transfer-driven change in beneficial ownership.
annual_compliance_calendar_matrix.delinquency_sanctions: Deficient or stale UBO/KYC documentation obliges the agent to escalate under the Vanuatu AML/CFT Act and may trigger a Suspicious Transaction Report; persistent non-completion may cause the agent to resign, and loss of the required registered agent can lead to administrative strike-off of the IC.

statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.compulsory_audit_thresholds: Not applicable - Vanuatu International Companies are statutorily exempt from independent audit and financial-statement filing under the International Companies Act (Cap. 222); no turnover, asset, or capital threshold triggers a mandatory audit for this wholesale-distribution IC. Compulsory audits attach only to domestic Vanuatu companies above local threshold rules and to VFSC-licensed financial institutions.
statutory_audit_and_accounting_mandate.governing_accounting_framework: No local GAAP or IFRS filing framework is prescribed because no statutory accounts are submitted to the VFSC; the board may voluntarily adopt IFRS or IFRS for SMEs for management and bank-financing purposes, and must maintain books adequate to explain transactions and financial position for at least 7 years.

corporate_registers_and_ubo_annual_confi.ubo_annual_confirmation_protocol: Vanuatu maintains no public UBO registry and imposes no annual UBO declaration to the VFSC for International Companies. Under the VFSC AML/CFT Rules, the licensed Registered Agent must identify, verify, and annually re-confirm all natural-person beneficial owners and controllers of the IC; the directors must pass written resolutions approving any share transfer, update the Register of Members within 30 days of transfer, and deliver the updated shareholding schedule to the agent for the annual CDD refresh. No economic-substance declaration or zero-tax attestation is required.

recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.registered_office_or_agent_market_range_: USD 700 - 1,500 per annum for the resident Registered Agent service, registered office, license-fee handling, and annual KYC/UBO compliance refresh
recurring_annual_maintenance_budget_usd.statutory_audit_estimated_fee_usd: Not required statutorily; voluntary certified audit for a wholesale optical-frames trading IC typically ranges USD 2,500 - 5,500

corporate_income_tax_regime.effective_tax_rate_incentives: N/A. Vanuatu imposes no corporate income tax, capital gains tax, or branch profits tax. An International Company is exempt by statutory status under the International Companies Act 1992, not by discretionary tax holiday. The exemption does not extend to the Vanuatu Value Added Tax of 15% on locally taxable supplies.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: N/A. No Vanuatu corporate income tax return exists. The Vanuatu Department of Customs and Inland Revenue administers VAT and customs duties, not corporate income tax. An International Company has no CIT form to file and cannot apply for an income tax certificate because no income tax regime is in force.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: None. No annual, quarterly, or monthly CIT filing frequency applies to an International Company in Vanuatu.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: No statutory CIT deadline exists. Tax-exempt status does not require periodic income tax declarations. The relevant compliance deadlines are VFSC annual fee and registry deadlines, plus VAT/customs obligations if taxable local activity commences.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: No field exists for taxable income, deductions, credits, or corporate tax payable because Vanuatu levies zero corporate tax on International Companies.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Non-resident shareholders, directors, and the International Company itself have no obligation to submit any income tax return, tax computation, or tax clearance certificate to DCIR in respect of international wholesale trading.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: No CIT late-filing penalties apply because no CIT return is required. However, if the International Company conducts VAT-liable activity in Vanuatu, failure to register or file VAT returns under the VAT Act 2010 triggers penalty assessments, default interest, criminal prosecution, and possible VFSC deregistration.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.form_identifier_and_portal: VFSC Annual Return and Government Fee, filed through the VFSC Online Portal or by the licensed registered agent on behalf of the International Company. Administered by the Vanuatu Financial Services Commission, not by DCIR.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.reporting_frequency: Annual, tied to the anniversary of incorporation.
tax_return_filing_anatomy.statutory_deadline_rule: The annual VFSC fee and return are due on or before each anniversary of the International Company's incorporation. A short administrative grace period may apply, but no general extension is granted without VFSC consent.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section A — Company Name and Registration Number
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Legal name and registration number exactly matching the Certificate of Incorporation.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: The International Company may be wholly owned by non-residents. The legal name is the English name on the VFSC certificate; trade names must be cross-referenced and separately recorded.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section B — Registered Agent and Registered Office
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Name and license number of the VFSC-licensed registered agent maintaining the registered office in Vanuatu.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: A foreign-owned International Company cannot provide a PO Box or substitute a foreign address. The registered office must be the physical address of the licensed agent in Vanuatu.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.line_or_box_code: Section C — Directors, Secretary and Beneficial Owners
field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Current directors, secretary, and ultimate beneficial owners of the International Company, including any nominee appointments.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: No Vanuatu resident director is statutorily required. Foreign natural persons or corporate directors are permitted. Beneficial ownership disclosure must identify any individual owning or controlling more than 25% of the company.

field_by_field_filling_dissection.entry_description: Confirmation that accounting records are maintained and a statement of the country or physical location where the records are kept.
field_by_field_filling_dissection.non_resident_entry_guidance: Records may be held outside Vanuatu, but the registered agent must have access to them for regulatory and AML purposes. Audited financial statements are not required for a standard International Company.

tax_return_filing_anatomy.failure_penalties: Late VFSC filing attracts late fees, default interest, and possible administrative strike-off. Continued non-compliance can result in deregistration of the International Company, loss of the limited liability shield, and prohibition on the registered agent continuing to act.

profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.statutory_dividend_wht_rate: 0%. Vanuatu imposes no withholding tax on dividends or other corporate distributions. A Vanuatu International Company may distribute profits to non-resident shareholders without any domestic dividend WHT.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.treaty_relief_application_protocol: No domestic dividend withholding tax exists, so no Vanuatu tax authority approval is required to repatriate dividends. Vanuatu has no comprehensive double tax agreement in force. The country has limited Tax Information Exchange Agreements only, which do not provide dividend WHT relief. A foreign shareholder claiming Vanuatu treaty benefits should not rely on a Vanuatu income tax residence certificate; DCIR will not issue an income tax TRC because Vanuatu has no corporate income tax. Foreign tax authorities should be provided with the Certificate of Incorporation, Certificate of Good Standing, VFSC annual fee receipt, and the International Company's UBO/registered agent record.
profit_repatriation_and_withholding_tax.cross_border_royalty_and_interest_wht: Domestic withholding tax on outbound royalties and interest: 0%. No Vanuatu statutory WHT applies to royalties, license fees, management fees, or debt interest paid by an International Company. Treaty rate: N/A because no comprehensive DTA is in force. Cross-border debt and royalty contracts should still reflect arm's length terms and be supported by written agreements to avoid recharacterization in the recipient jurisdiction.

transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.tp_documentation_threshold_local_currenc: VUV 0. Vanuatu has no corporate income tax and has not enacted a statutory transfer pricing documentation regime. Therefore no Local File, Master File, or CbC reporting threshold applies in Vanuatu. For customs and VAT purposes, related-party import prices must nonetheless be based on the transaction value and an arm's length price to avoid revaluation.
transfer_pricing_and_economic_substance.economic_substance_doctrine: Vanuatu does not currently administer a formal Economic Substance Regulations filing regime comparable to BVI or Cayman for International Companies. No annual ESR report is filed with VFSC solely on the basis of holding an International Company. However, under FATF/OECD transparency standards and VFSC regulatory practice, the International Company must avoid being characterized as a shell: it should maintain accounting records, board minutes, a bank account, a licensed registered agent, and commercial documentation for the wholesale eyewear frame transactions. The absence of genuine substance may trigger foreign CFC rules, GAAR adjustments, refusal of banking services, and deregistration risk.
